extDescription.message: Turns the selected part of a page into clean Markdown and copies it to the clipboard. AI-ready sessions and tables for Google Sheets.

buttonTitle.message: Convert selection to Markdown and copy

modeSmartHint.message: Smart removes ads, share buttons and hidden elements while keeping the content.

modeStrictHint.message: Strict also cuts navigation, footers and sidebars.

onboardingStep1.message: Select some text on any page.

onboardingStep2.message: Click the MD button next to the selection, press the keyboard shortcut or use the button above.

onboardingStep3.message: The Markdown lands in your clipboard. Paste it anywhere.

alreadyInSession.message: This fragment is already in the session.

copyTableHint.message: Copies the table as TSV. Paste it into Google Sheets or Excel.

tableCopied.message: Table copied. Paste it into Google Sheets or Excel.

sessionEmptyText.message: Turn on “Collect into session” or click “Add to session” next to a result. Copy all collected fragments at once, e.g. into Claude.

aiInstructionPlaceholder.message: E.g. Draft an article outline based on the documents.

aiPresetSummary.message: Summarize the documents above. List the key takeaways as bullet points and cite the source document number for each.

aiPresetFacts.message: Extract concrete facts, figures and dates from the documents above. For each one, give a verbatim quote and the document number. Do not add information that is not in the documents.

aiPresetCompare.message: Compare the documents above: where they agree, where they differ and what each one is missing. Answer with a Markdown table followed by a short summary.

copyForAiHint.message: Fragments grouped by source in <document> tags, the format recommended for Claude. The instruction goes at the end.

copiedForAi.message: Session copied for AI. Paste it into Claude or another chat.

showButtonLabel.message: Show the MD button next to selections

excludedHint.message: The MD button won't appear on these sites or their subdomains. The shortcut and context menu keep working.

errorDomain.message: That doesn't look like a valid domain.

shortcutHint.message: Conversion shortcut. Change it in the Settings tab.

shortcutMissing.message: Not set (e.g. conflict with another extension)

statusReady.message: Select text on the page and click “Convert selection”.

statusLastResult.message: Your last result is below. Select new text to replace it.

toastCopiedAndSaved.message: Copied and added to session ($ARG1$, fragments in session: $ARG2$).

toastDuplicate.message: Copied. This fragment is already in the session.

toastNearQuota.message: The session is close to the storage limit: copy it and clear it.

toastSaveFailed.message: Copied, but saving to the session failed. Copy and clear the session.

toastCopyFailed.message: Copying failed. Open the extension window: the result is waiting in the Result tab.

errorNoSelection.message: Select some text on the page first.

errorEmpty.message: The selection has no content to convert.

errorRestricted.message: Chrome doesn't allow extensions to read this page (e.g. chrome://, Chrome Web Store, PDF viewer).

errorFileAccess.message: To work on local files, turn on “Allow access to file URLs” in the extension details.

errorGeneric.message: Something went wrong. Reload the page and try again.
